# M18-S7 REDTEAM #194: eject keeps a region program's output.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^7 42 6$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=

logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regionparity

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

type node struct {
	v int
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[node](r)
	p.v = 7
	s := arena.Make[int](r, 3)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = i * i
	}
	t := arena.Append[int](r, nil, 1, 2, 3)
	sum := 0
	for _, v := range t {
		sum += v
	}
	fmt.Println(p.v, p.v*6, sum)
}
